g.text: Publishing a report is a separate driver action.
Device detection only suggests a candidate.
Only active, unexpired reports accept transitions.
Departure confirmation and upcoming cancellation require the author.
AVAILABLE observations do not reopen reports or renew expiresAt.
Backend checks age, accuracy and distance to the reported position.
A manually selected map point is not proximity evidence.
center and radius are explicitly selected by the driver.
Phone movement does not change them.
active state, expiry and selected filters.
Confidence is a heuristic indicator, not a validated probability.
Reference zones do not imply that a spot is currently free.
GeoPoint and GeoGeometry are geographic value types; Instant is a timestamp.
TTL and proximity thresholds are configurable; numeric values remain to be chosen.
Domain classes describe responsibilities and relationships, not a database schema.
